versions.changelog: 默认返回最终采集结果，完善异步等待下载与安全恢复；修复空目标误执行、Quick Start、Token 配置和触发路由冲突，并补齐发布前自动化测试
新增能力路由与异步任务闭环，修复失效引用、Token 泄漏和 Skill 元数据兼容性
补全中文文档，更新目录结构

Initial release of dataify-facebook-post-by-url skill.

- Enables submission of Dataify Facebook post collection jobs by post URL via Dataify Builder.
- Guides users through required/optional parameter selection, including support for multiple URLs.
- Provides clear API TOKEN handling instructions with secure local storage suggestions.
- Outputs task ID, status, and dashboard link on successful job submission.
- Includes troubleshooting steps for common errors like missing API TOKEN or invalid URLs.
